sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-12-01') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-12-01') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) = 25
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c')
